games.desc:
(UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL: PRONE TO ISSUES)

(⚠️DISCLAIMER⚠️) This is a recreation of Landfall/Landfall West's "Stick Fight: The Game" which is available on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. In-game music was created by Karl Flodin for the original Stick Fight: The Game. If you want an experience that's made by actual good developers, the original Stick Fight: The Game is only $4.99.

This game makes Roblox into a 2D game, so expect bugs and issues. Certain aspects like server performance and mobile support are not the best, so it's highly recommended to play in a Private Server if you can.

Left Click / R2 & X Button = Attack
Right Click & F / L2 = Block
F / Y Button = Throw Weapon
A & D / Left Joystick = Movement
W & Space / A Button & L1 = Jump
S / Left Joystick Down = Crouch

SCP: Site Roleplay
games.desc:
Hidden beneath the frozen tundra of Northern Canada lies SCP Foundation Containment Site-64, an ultra-classified facility controlled by an organization that studies and contains the supernatural. Site-64 operates at the brink of catastrophe at all times, facing constant escape attempts by dangerous anomalies, violent sabotage by Chaos Insurgents or Hostile Test Subjects, and a relentless scientific drive to research, even when doing so endangers the world.

Defend the facility as a Security, discover the unknown as a Scientist, endure dangerous experiments as a Class-D, or fight to dismantle the Foundation as an Insurgent or Hostile Test Subject. 

SECURE. CONTAIN. PROTECT.
